description:
🎄 Craving the perfect holiday treat? Today, I’m making Gingerbread Cookie Ice Cream in the Ninja Creami, and trust me—it’s as delicious as it sounds! This festive flavor is packed with all the warm spices of gingerbread cookies, combined with the creamy, dreamy texture only the Ninja Creami can deliver. Whether you’re a fan of holiday desserts or just love experimenting with creative ice cream recipes, this is a must-try! 🍦✨

👉 Watch as I break down the step-by-step process, share tips for achieving the perfect consistency, and show you how to incorporate real gingerbread cookies for that authentic holiday flavor.


💬 Don’t forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE for more mouthwatering recipes and Ninja Creami hacks. What flavor should I make next? Let me know in the comments below!

-------------------

🕒 TIMESTAMPS
0:00:00 - Intro
0:54:18 - Ingredients Overview
0:59:18 - Making the Gingerbread Cookies
3:58 - Cutting out the cookies
5:56 - Making the ice cream base
8:34 - Spinning and Adding
9:23 - Scooping and close


----------------

📋 INGREDIENTS LIST:

375g All-purpose flour (2.25 cups + 1 tbsp)
165g Dark brown sugar , packed (3/4 cup)
4.5g Baking soda (1 tsp)
8g Ground cinnamon (scant 2 tsp)
5g Ground ginger (1 tsp)
1g Ground cloves (1/4 tsp)
3g Salt (1/2 tsp)
170g Butter , room temperature, cut into pieces (3/4 cup)
252g Molasses (dark molasses) (3/4 cup)
30g Milk (2 tbsp)
